name: TechCare API Product Sync for WooCommerce
author: habibalafeef

sections.description:
TechCare API Product Sync connects your WooCommerce store to a supplier’s REST API and imports its products: names, descriptions, prices, images, categories, and products with sizes and colours.

Press “Test connection” and the plugin reads a sample of the API’s response and works out which field is the name, the price, the stock and the images. You check the result, change any field you need, and press Sync.

Watch the whole setup, from pasting the API link to the products appearing in the shop. The narration is in Arabic: press CC for English subtitles.

Free features

  • Connect any JSON REST API (Bearer token or a token in a custom header, such as CJdropshipping’s)
  • Automatic field detection, with a manual override for every field
  • Simple and variable products (sizes, colours and other options)
  • Product images, linked from the source
  • Categories and SKUs
  • Price markup by percentage
  • One-click manual sync with live progress: new products are added, and prices, stock and details of the ones you already imported are updated
  • Activity log
  • Arabic and English interface, right-to-left aware
  • API secrets are stored encrypted

The free edition reads your API address once per sync, exactly as you enter it, and runs while the plugin page is open in your browser.

Pro features

Try every Pro feature free for 7 days, no card needed, on up to 50 new products from your own API. Everything you import stays in your shop when the trial ends.

  • Pagination: reads your API page by page, for catalogues of 10,000+ products
  • Background sync on the server: start it and close the page
  • Automatic sync on a schedule
  • Fast price and stock updates that skip everything else
  • Advanced pricing: fixed amount, minimum price, rounding (such as .99) and exchange rate
  • Remove products that left the source, with a safety limit
  • Protect your manual edits from being overwritten
  • Import filters: price, stock, keywords and categories
  • More ways to connect: Basic auth, a key in the URL, OAuth2 and HMAC-signed requests
  • Download images into the media library

External services

This plugin connects only to the API URL you enter in its settings, to read your supplier’s products. It sends that API the authentication details you configure, and nothing else about your site or your visitors.

Product images are shown from the addresses that API returns, so your visitors’ browsers load them from your supplier’s image servers (or wherever the API says they are).

The plugin uses the Freemius SDK for upgrades and licences. After activation it asks whether you want to share basic, non-sensitive diagnostic data with Freemius (your site URL, WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and your admin email). Nothing is sent unless you opt in, and you can opt out at any time from the Plugins screen. Buying Pro and managing your licence also go through Freemius. See the Freemius terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload, or install it from the plugin directory, then activate it.
  3. Open “API Product Sync” in the admin menu.
  4. In Settings, enter your API URL and, if needed, your token, then press “Test connection”.
  5. Review the detected fields, save, and press “Sync now” on the dashboard.
sections.faq:
Which APIs does it work with?

Any REST API that returns products as JSON, whether at the top level or inside a wrapper such as data or products.

Does it work with CJdropshipping?

Yes. Set the authentication to a custom header, with CJ-Access-Token as the header name and your access token as the value.

My API returns its products page by page. Which edition do I need?

The free edition reads the address you enter once, exactly as entered, so it imports what that one request returns. Reading every page of a large catalogue is part of Pro, which you can try free for 7 days.

What happens when the Pro trial ends?

Nothing you imported is removed. Automatic and background syncing stop, and you can keep syncing by hand as in the free edition.

Will it delete my existing products?

No. The free edition only adds and updates the products it imported itself, and never deletes anything on its own. Removing products that left the source is a Pro feature, with a safety limit that stops it if too many would go at once.

Where are my API credentials stored?

In your WordPress database, encrypted with keys derived from your site’s own security salts.
